scope: Remaining Demigra/Supervillain cast-only Super skills with dedicated taxonomy evidence

records.name: Energy Cannon
records.effect: Creates turrets that fire a volley of small Ki Blasts followed by three large Ki Blasts.

records.name: Darkness Mixer
records.character_source: Yamcha (Supervillain) and other Supervillain/Raid characters; Demon God Demigra
records.effect: Charge Super that rapidly restores Ki and also restores Stamina while emitting a damaging dark aura; normally unavailable to CaCs.

notes: Both records were absent from docs/data/skills.json and had not been represented by an earlier research batch. Energy Cannon has explicit Super/Ki Blast taxonomy and cast-only Demigra ownership. Darkness Mixer has explicit Other Super taxonomy and cast-only status. Numeric Ki costs remain null where the dedicated sources do not provide them.
